name: Wind Integration National Dataset (WIND) Toolkit
description: A large-scale meteorological and wind-power dataset for the contiguous United States, providing modeled time series of wind speed, direction, and other weather variables at multiple heights and locations for wind energy analysis.
citation: Draxl, C., Clifton, A., Hodge, B.-M., & McCaa, J. (2015). The Wind Integration National Dataset (WIND) Toolkit. Applied Energy, 151, 355–366. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.apenergy.2015.03.121

license.identifier: Provider terms; dataset-wide license not specified
license.notes: The upstream WIND Toolkit site does not identify a standard SPDX license for the dataset. This descriptive identifier is not an SPDX identifier; review current NREL access and use terms before using or redistributing data.
